req.title: Posts include author username
req.statement: The system shall join post rows with users so index/detail responses include the author's username.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return posts with the author's username included. This involves testing the integration of the posts and users tables, ensuring that the join operation is correctly implemented and that the API returns the expected data structure. We need to test positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_posts_include_author_username_positive
preconditions: Database initialized with a user and a post by that user
expected: Response contains post with author's username
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute("INSERT INTO user (id, username, password) VALUES (1, 'testuser', 'testpass')")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO post (id, title, body, author_id) VALUES (1, 'Test Title', 'Test Body', 1)")
    db.commit()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'testuser' in r.data
assert b'Test Title' in r.data

tests.name: test_posts_include_author_username_boundary
preconditions: Database initialized with a user and a post by that user
expected: Response contains exactly one post with author's username
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db, get_db
    init_db()
    db = get_db()
    db.execute("INSERT INTO user (id, username, password) VALUES (1, 'testuser', 'testpass')")
    db.execute("INSERT INTO post (id, title, body, author_id) VALUES (1, 'Boundary Title', 'Boundary Body', 1)")
    db.commit()

r = client.get('/')
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'testuser' in r.data
assert b'Boundary Title' in r.data
